items.t: 星際太陽帆在75%光速時遇到奇怪問題
items.x: 科學家發現了星際旅行的一個令人驚訝的障礙：在極端速度下，推動未來太陽帆的光實際上可能開始減慢它們的速度。一旦太空船達到光速的 75%，一些散射光就會開始產生阻力，這可能會使人類到達遙遠恆星的計畫變得複雜。
items.orig: Interstellar solar sails hit a bizarre problem at 75% of light speed
items.origX: Scientists have discovered a surprising obstacle to interstellar travel: at extreme speeds, the light propelling futuristic solar sails could actually begin slowing them down. Once a spacecraft reaches 75% of the speed of light, some scattered light starts producing drag, potentially complicating humanity’s plans to reach distant stars.

items.t: 非經典碳正離子合成六取代苯
items.x: 苯環是小分子藥物中最常見的環系1。然而，由於合成方面的挑戰以及市售芳香族結構單元的可用性有限，小分子庫中明顯不存在具有六個取代基的苯。因此，新的化學製程能夠透過可預測的區域化學合成它們
items.orig: Hexa-substituted benzene synthesis with non-classical carbocations
items.origX: Benzene rings are the most frequently encountered ring system in small-molecule drugs1. However, benzenes with six substituents are notably absent from small molecule libraries, owing to challenges associated with their synthesis and the limited availability of commercially available aromatic building blocks2. Therefore, new chemical processes that enable their synthesis with predictable regiochemical control and broad substituent diversity could enable medicinal chemists to explore this uncharted aromatic chemical space in hit-to-lead and lead optimization campaigns. Herein, we describe a highly modular and programmable platform for accessing hexa-substituted benzene rings from aromatic cyclopropenium cations and (trialkylsilyl)allenes, with precise control over all six benzene positions encoded in the starting materials. The exceptional regioselectivity observed originates from the selective evolution of an unusual non-classical carbocation featuring four-centre four-electron bonding as revealed by density functional theory calculations. Our benzannulation enables the selective installation of synthetic handles that were exploited for the synthesis of previously inaccessible penta- and hexa-substituted analogues of the anticancer drug sonidegib and the antihypertensive drug telmisartan, as well as the polyaromatic hydrocarbon triphenylene. Notably, the use of enantiopure allenes unlocks a new route to enantioenriched multi-substituted biaryls through our benzannulation occurring with 「memory of chirality」.

items.t: 角膜太薄無法近視雷射？眼科醫師解析「植入式隱形眼鏡」EVO ICL，保留角膜且可隨時取出！
items.x: 高度近視或角膜太薄無法做近視雷射嗎？「EVO ICL植入式隱形眼鏡」保留完整角膜結構，不僅能降低術後乾眼風險，晶體更具備可取出的彈性，是視力矯正的安全新選擇。

items.t: 為什麼氫火焰會發出橙色光，然後幾乎看不見
items.x: 氫火焰可以從亮橙色轉變為幾乎看不見，這取決於一些意想不到的情況：空氣中漂浮著微量的鈉。科學家表示，這項發現可以透過用專門的感測器取代視覺火焰檢測來幫助未來的氫動力爐和烤箱更安全。
items.orig: Why hydrogen flames can glow orange, then turn nearly invisible
items.origX: Hydrogen flames can shift from bright orange to nearly invisible depending on something unexpected: tiny amounts of sodium floating in the air. Scientists say this discovery could help make future hydrogen-powered stoves and ovens safer by replacing visual flame detection with specialized sensors.

items.t: 連續 N-C 勝肽合成
items.x: 目前最先進的勝肽合成在效率和可持續性方面面臨著重大的全球挑戰。 1隨著對勝肽治療藥物的需求迅速增長，2,3我們提供這些重要藥物的能力面臨越來越大的壓力。 4化學合成通常進行C到N並需要保護基團，而核醣體合成是從未受保護的胺基酸進行N到C
items.origX: Current state-of-the-art peptide synthesis faces a significant global challenge in efficiency and sustainability.1 With demand for peptide therapeutics growing rapidly,2,3 our ability to provide these important medicines is under increasing pressure.4 Chemical synthesis typically proceeds C-to-N and requires protecting groups, whereas ribosomal synthesis proceeds N-to-C from unprotected amino acids (AAs). To improve efficiency and sustainability, we developed a continuous N-to-C Peptide Synthesis (NCPS) using N-/C-unprotected AAs or fragments without intermediate isolations, achieving ≥95% average yield per coupling and ≤1.0% epimerization. The method enabled seven consecutive couplings. Starting from N-/C-unprotected AAs, peptide assembly requires fewer isolations than those needed to prepare the corresponding Fmoc-AA building blocks before conventional synthesis can begin. This method accepts all 20 canonical AAs and a wide range of non-canonical AAs important for drug-like profiles.5 Longer peptides can be readily assembled through continuous fragment coupling while maintaining chiral integrity. This approach reduces isolations by ~10-fold and waste generation by up to ~100-fold. We further developed a flow synthesizer that enhances speed and productivity while mitigating batch manufacturing risks. The method enabled the synthesis of a tirzepatide heptapeptide fragment, degarelix, a 14-mer engineered macrocyclic peptide, and semaglutide. Overall, continuous NCPS has the potential to transform peptide manufacturing.

items.t: 一年吞下5億顆安眠藥！大腦當機睡不著？新型藥物與 CBT-I 帶你找回「關機力」
items.x: 台灣人一年吃掉超過 5 億顆安眠藥，平均一天吞下 138 萬顆！難道我們真的這麼難入睡嗎？面對漫漫長夜，許多人依賴藥物來強制大腦關機，但安眠藥吃久了怕成癮、擔心戒不掉，甚至憂慮會引發失智。到底失眠一定要吃藥嗎？吃了十年的藥還有機會戒除嗎？這一集，就讓挺健康鄭丁…

items.t: 這種以史蒂芬·科爾伯特 (Stephen Colbert) 命名的小蜘蛛的基因組比人類大 50%
items.x: 一種以 Stephen Colbert 命名的加州小型活板門蜘蛛，儘管其體型只有四分之一，但其基因組卻比人類大 50%。科學家發現其龐大的基因組包含 46 億個 DNA 鹼基對和 52 條染色體，揭示了有關蜘蛛進化的驚人線索。
items.orig: This tiny spider named after Stephen Colbert has a genome 50% larger than a human’s
items.origX: A tiny California trapdoor spider named after Stephen Colbert has a genome roughly 50% larger than a human's, despite being only about the size of a quarter. Scientists discovered that its enormous genome contains 4.6 billion DNA base pairs and 52 chromosomes, revealing surprising clues about spider evolution.
